topSignals.title: Elcogen: confirmed quiet for an eighth straight day.
topSignals.text: Direct newsroom check (elcogen.com/category/news) shows nothing posted since the Aug 31 write-up of the Aug 24 Paris MoU with China Southern Power Grid group company Guangzhou Xinzhili Energy Technology. Status unchanged: elcoStack E3000 G2 platform (>75% FC electrical efficiency, 90% with heat recovery, 650°C) in volume production at ELCO I Tallinn (360 MW/yr). Elcogen News

topSignals.title: Topsoe: SOFC/SOEC side still quiet; only new item is off-topic (battery materials, not fuel cells).
topSignals.text: Direct press-releases check shows nothing beyond the already-logged Aug 27 H1 2026 results and March 2026 SOEC pathway reset. The one new Topsoe item this week — a Sept 1 announcement of 1,500-cycle/80%-capacity durability for its cobalt-free LNMO cathode material (with Guangzhou Tinci Materials) — is EV battery-materials technology, a separate Topsoe business line unrelated to SOFC/SOEC; logged here only so it isn't mistaken for a fuel-cell development. Topsoe LNMO breakthrough | Topsoe press releases

topSignals.title: Housekeeping note: an "Oracle triple-SMR gigawatt data center" story recirculating in aggregator/AI-generated content this week is a 2024 announcement, not new.
topSignals.text: Several low-quality outlets are republishing Larry Ellison's September 2024 announcement (three SMRs for a 1 GW data center, location undisclosed, no timeline) with 2026 datelines. Verified against Data Center Frontier/Tom's Hardware originals — flagging so this doesn't get miscarried into a future digest as breaking news.

items.text: Elcogen (priority): See Top Signal #1. No other announcements found from Elcogen this week.
Topsoe (priority): See Top Signal #2. No SOFC/SOEC-specific announcement identified.

Ceres Power: Direct newsroom check confirms most recent item is still the Sept 1 "Net Zero Champion" award (Engineering Matters Awards) — nothing new since. No update on the Centrica/Delta Electronics partnership or H1 2026 results (due Sept 23).
No new stack/cell announcements found from Bloom, Sunfire, SolydEra, Mitsubishi Power, Kyocera, Aisin, or Convion.
